# ERP Academy

> ERP Academy by Akshay is India's leading SAP training institute specializing in SAP MM, SAP HANA, and SAP FI certification with 100% placement support.

ERP Academy provides live, hands-on training led by senior SAP consultant Akshay Kumar (6+ years experience). Over 500+ professionals trained with a 95% placement record at top MNCs like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and Accenture.

## Courses

- [SAP MM Training Course](https://erp-academy.vercel.app/courses/sap-mm): Comprehensive 10-12 weeks training on procurement, inventory, master data (BP), OBYC account determination, and S/4HANA sourcing.
- [SAP HANA Training Course](https://erp-academy.vercel.app/courses/sap-hana): In-memory computing, Calculation Views, CDS Views, AMDP, SLT provisioning, and S/4HANA migration.
- [SAP FI Training Course](https://erp-academy.vercel.app/courses/sap-fi): General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, and S/4HANA Universal Journal (ACDOCA).

## Technical Articles & Guides

- [SAP MM Training in India 2025: Fees, Duration & Placement](https://erp-academy.vercel.app/blog/sap-mm-training-india): Complete guide to SAP MM course fees, duration, syllabus, and job opportunities.
- [SAP Salary in India 2025](https://erp-academy.vercel.app/blog/sap-salary-india-2025): Detailed salary benchmarks for SAP MM, HANA, and FI consultants across experience levels.
- [SAP Training vs MBA in India](https://erp-academy.vercel.app/blog/sap-training-vs-mba-india): Head-to-head comparison of ROI, duration, cost, and career trajectories.
- [SAP MM Tutorial for Beginners](https://erp-academy.vercel.app/blog/sap-mm-tutorial-beginners): 30-day learning roadmap and essential transaction codes cheat sheet.
- [How to Get an SAP Job After Training](https://erp-academy.vercel.app/blog/sap-job-after-training-india): Blueprint for resume optimization, mock interviews, and landing consultant offers.
